title: Study time in hours
prompt: The weekly report shows study time in hours as well as minutes. Write `solve(attempts)` so it returns `attempt_id`, `learner_id`, `minutes` (the `minutes_spent` column renamed) and `hours`, which is the minutes divided by 60.
rules: Return exactly four columns, in this order: `attempt_id`, `learner_id`, `minutes`, `hours`.
When the minutes are missing, both `minutes` and `hours` are missing. Keep every attempt.
hints: Arithmetic on a column gives a new column: `F.col("minutes_spent") / 60`.
A computed column gets an awkward name like `(minutes_spent / 60)` until you give it one with `.alias("hours")`.
